title: Pokemon TCG Ho-Oh Celebrations Classic Collection 001/025 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and unique Ho-Oh Pokémon card is a must-have for any collector or fan of the game. With its stunning holo finish and intricate design, this card is sure to be a standout addition to any collection. The card features the iconic Ho-Oh character, a powerful dragon Pokémon, and is part of the Celebrations: Classic Collection set.

This card is not only visually impressive, but it also boasts a number of special features including being stamped, a collectors edition, and has an unlimited print run. Additionally, it is autographed and features unique art, making it a true gem for any Pokémon TCG enthusiast. Don't miss out on the opportunity to add this amazing Ho-Oh card to your collection.
